prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for adoption new_flow, finish copy, finish hint, finish redesign, sign_in hint, sign_in notification, and sign_in reorder because each has only been tested once.
For choose_path copy changes (2 tests), no clear effect was seen in either test.
For choose_path redesign changes (2 tests), no clear effect was seen in either test.
For home wait_info changes (4 tests), no clear winning effect was demonstrated, with three tests showing no clear effect and one rolled back due to a guardrail.
For adoption redesign changes (2 tests), results disagree with one winning test and one showing no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently overly optimistic compared to noise-corrected measurements across most tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +0.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Changes:
0: [home, new_screen] Interactive Desk Companion Mini Game: Adds an interactive desk toy mini-game screen during the waiting stage while background pet creation completes. (why: Home stage has high median (201s) and mean (2336s) duration, causing drop-offs; providing a mini-game keeps users engaged.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Voice and Personality Setup Flow: Inserts a dedicated personality and voice selector screen right before the final adoption certificate is issued. (why: Adoption stage experiences significant drop-off (66.2% conversion); adding high-value personalization deepens emotional investment before finalization.)
2: [home, wait_info] Pet Hatching Animation Progress Info: Adds an animated hatching pet graphic and background status explanation to the waiting screen. (why: Support receives tickets about desktop pet apps stalling, and the home stage mean duration is 2336s.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Account Recovery and Instant Reconnect Copy: Updates sign-in copy to explicitly highlight pet retrieval and existing account protection. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or account reset confusion after signing in.)
4: [finish, hint] Desktop Overlay Hotkey Helper Hint: Displays an explicit hotkey shortcut tip on the final screen explaining how to toggle desktop visibility. (why: Support received multiple inquiries post-onboarding asking how to hide or reveal the desktop pet.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Sound Alert: Adds a sound cue component and explicit notification message when waiting finishes. (why: Home mean time is over 38 minutes as users switch windows; an audio chime alerts them when the pet is ready.)
6: [choose_path, hint] Path Switch Flexibility Guarantee Hint: Adds reassurance text stating paths and companion types can be switched anytime in settings. (why: High mean decision time on choose_path (514s) points to user hesitation over making an irreversible choice.)
